title: To Assess the Safety, Immunogenicity and Efficacy of VLPM01 in Healthy, Malaria-Naïve Volunteers
brief_summary: This study is a proof-of-concept, first in human, Phase I, single center study designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, immunogenicity and experimental efficacy of VLPM01 in healthy, malaria-naïve adult volunteers. The VLPM01 product will be adjuvanted with alhydrogel. The study design was based on the FDA's guidance "General Principles for the Development of Vaccines to protect Against Global Infectious Diseases" (2011).
